title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

title: Tejas
desc: Brave IAF officer Tejas undertakes a perilous mission to rescue an Indian spy from deep inside Pakistan, all while battling enemies outside-and haunting memories within.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: A rock star, labourer, doctor, and cop struggle with a drug crisis in Punjab. Their lives intertwine as they fight addiction and chaos.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Chocolate-Deep Dark Secret
desc: Five Indians in London are caught in chaos when two are accused of a bomb blast. An Indian lawyer steps in, fighting against time and odds to prove their innocence.

title: Company
desc: Chandu and Mallik form a gang and gain notoriety. But ego and tension tear them apart, leading to betrayal and the collapse of their criminal empire.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: Plain-looking Chanda is shocked to find that her husband is married to an attractive woman. What will Chanda do?

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A young woman, duped and sold to a brothel, rises above despair. Using underworld connections, she transforms from pawn to ruler, commanding power in a ruthless world.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Sikandar
desc: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.
